segments.text: Ayame is Makoto's mother (by remarriage) and has no blood ties to him.

She accidentally met Makoto's father 10 years ago when she went back to the store to rent a movie. She had really enjoyed the store and moved closer to Makoto's father. They got along very well and ended up getting married. She has since devoted her life to her new family, quickly adopting Makoto and considering him as if he were her own son and that even after the death of her husband.

Before Makoto left for the city, they both ran the store and were very close. As soon as Makoto left for her studies, she started running the shop alone before Kaho came to Ayame's place to help her. They then started to live together.

They get along rather well and are friends despite their big differences. However, Ayame noticed that something was strange in Kaho's behavior : She was secretly going to Makoto's room to do dubious things.

Seeing Kaho as a potential danger to her son's integrity, she starts to watch her more closer. When it comes to Makoto, Ayame turns into a super protective mom and sees Kaho as a danger ... Or maybe she sees Makoto as more than her son ?
Ayame has very little sexual experience. She seems to have known only Makoto's father and was not married to him very long since he died shortly after they got together.
穏やかで厳しさと優しさを兼ね備えた、真面目タイプ。
ゆったり癒し系。
自立した女性。というよりも『母』
昔風の良妻賢母のイメージをベースに、年の近い『姉』の雰囲気を兼ね備えた女性。
ごくごくたまにドジ。しかも壮絶、なのはご愛敬。
三歩退いて、後ろから見守るタイプ。
反面、悩みを他人に相談することは苦手。
主人公に対しては、激アマ。
主人公から見ると、優しいお姉さん。
姉と母と、足して２で割ったようなポジション。
なので、主人公と年が近い……１０歳差くらいで、見た目、親子というよりは姉弟。
主人公が12歳の頃に嫁いできた義母。
ゆったり癒し系。 穏やかで厳しさと優しさを兼ね備えた まじめタイプ。
主人公に対しては激アマ。
主人公にとっては優しいお姉さんで、姉と母を足して割ったようなポジション。
歳の差は10ほどしか変わらず、一見親子というよりは姉弟のように見える。

Kaho is the little sister of Makoto's father and so is Makoto's aunt. However, their age difference is not great (10 years maximum) and Makoto considers her as his big sister (because she speaks and acts like a boy) and she also sees him as her little brother.

She loved Makoto from the day of his birth and came to play with him well before the death of his sister-in-law. When her sister-in-law died, she played a very, very important role in Makoto's life. She comforted him, played with him and took baths with him although she was already a high school girl. It was during this period that she began to sexually harass him and dress provocatively. Her relationship with Makoto remained unchanged until Ayame came into their lives. She had to stop some things even though Ayame and Kaho became good friends.

Some time after high school, Kaho married and a few years later, her brother died (Makoto's father). Years later, when Makoto left for university, Kaho asked her husband if she could go live with Ayame to help run the shop and he agreed (Kaho would have gone there even without his permission because her husband work away and is almost never at home). She mainly manages the adult department.

Kaho (sexually) has always wanted Makoto and when Ayame isn't here, she secretly enters Makoto's room to do some things. When Makoto returns, she resumes sexual harassment (which is sometimes open proposals) and even tells him that she wants to be the one who will take his virginity. However, Ayame is still putting herself between them and - in these moments - Kaho considered her as an obstacle that prevents her from getting closer to her Makoto.

Kaho takes care of her body and her appearance. She knows she is very attractive : She has a generous bosom and harmonious curves, she is thin and she shaves completely in order to be able to seduce Makoto.

In reality, Kaho has big marital problems and her marriage isn't going well at all. Her husband is never there and the few times they see each other, they argue. She hasn't had sex with her husband for years. Although her marriage went very badly, she never cheated on her husband and she tries to maintain her marriage.
She acts in front of Makoto like if she was "slutty" but in reality she is like that only with him (because she has feelings for him).
主人公にとっては、年上のセクシーなお姉さん。性的誘惑お姉さん。
人妻。専業主婦、とはいえ、単身赴任中の夫とあまり上手くいかず、日中の暇をもてあまして、遊び半分で、お店のアルバイトをしている。
勝ち気で、活動的で、社交的、新しいモノ楽しいこと、派手なことが大好き
熱しやすく醒めやすい性格、言いたい事は、ハッキリと口にする。物怖じしない性格。
母親を失ったばかりの美樹本家を支えてくれた父親の妹、主人公の叔母。
勝ち気で活動的で社交的。 新しいモノや楽しいこと、派手なことが大好き。
物怖じしない性格で、言いたいことはハッキリと言うサバサバした女性。
主人公にとっては、年上のセクシーなお姉さん。
専業主婦だが夫は単身赴任中なので、遊び半分でよくお店を手伝ってくれる。

Makoto is the protagonist of the story. He lost his mother very young and has almost no memories of her, so his father raised him alone for a while. His aunt Kaho (his father's little sister), who was still a student at the time, often visited him so that he wouldn't feel alone and act like a big sister for Makoto. She often bothered him, played with him, and took baths with him.
His father opened a video rental store (VHS then DVD/CD/GAME) and met 10 years ago Ayame with whom he remarried. Makoto could never see her as his mother and Ayame became his first love.
Some time later, Kaho married and Makoto's father died, leaving his new wife and Makoto alone. After a few years, Makoto finished high school and moved to another city to start university.
A year later, after failing his exams, Makoto returns to his native village to find two frustrated women, Kaho and Ayame ...
ごく普通の青年。
幼くして母を亡くし１２歳の時に父が再婚。
温厚で真面目、協調的、ごく普通にスケベ。
ただし、外見がそれなりに整っていて、しかも、地毛が茶髪で、どうしても「遊んでいる」風に見られてしまうため、周りからのそういう印象に、本人は困っている。
ごく普通の青年。 温厚でまじめ、ごく普通にスケベ。
外見はそれなりに整っていて、茶髪なので遊んでいるように見られてしまう。
幼くして母を亡くし、12歳の時に父が再婚。
その後 父も亡くなり、義母と二人暮らしをしている。
